name: Shiva hippocampus signal (fast, 3x)
origin: Shiva software by Todd Murphy (signal templates licensed from Persinger and Koren)
summary: Murphy's simple Shiva hippocampus session with the 'LTP' theta-burst signal played three times faster, stepped counter-clockwise around the head. The vendor presents the hippocampal signal for cognitive, non-verbal, imagery and intuition effects.
notes: Coils sit on Murphy's Shiva ring (Fp1, FT7, TP7, O1, O2, TP8, FT8, Fp2; one coil per site instead of Shiva's coil pairs) and step counter-clockwise seen from above, with Murphy's lecture example of 10, 12 ... 20 ms per coil (about 8 rotations a second; Murphy writes 'around 9 times per second'). Phase 1 (20 min) is the 20-min version; phase 2 makes it the 30-min version (a 60-min Shiva version also exists). The Shiva LTP file is proprietary. The normal-speed approximation (trains of 4 theta bursts of 4 biphasic pulses at 3-ms points, bursts every 186 ms = 5.4 Hz, the vendor's reported LTP spectral peak, then 4 s of silence) is played here at 1-ms points, three times faster: pulses 3 ms apart, bursts every 62 ms (16 Hz), a 248-ms train every 1.58 s. Murphy's Shakti 'high-speed' signals likewise use 1-ms points and drop the latency; whether Shiva's fast version shortens or drops it is not published, so it is shortened 3x with the rest of the signal. Murphy's cautions: word-finding problems or feeling 'spaced out' mean switch to another signal; about 2% get headaches or pressure, in which case lower the intensity by one-third. Independent double-blind tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012). Not for people with epilepsy; stop if distressed.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed, relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. Shiva offers 20, 30 and 60-min versions; start with the short one.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break. 60-min sessions weekly or every two weeks at most.
